In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of systems which can be adapted to the changing requirements of their users.
developing information systems which adapt to organizational requirements, rather than vice versa.
developing a design methodology which enables systems to adapt to changing requirements, and with developing a system which can implement such a methodology.

the system described in this paper is a prototype for the design of information systems which are adaptable to their organizational host.
the environment is a design for a class of information systems which can evolve to meet the changing requirements of their host organizations.
the environment described is an attempt to make the system more flexible and adaptable, and to reduce the amount of time spent in maintenance.
